payloader.h264: h264parse config-interval=-1 ! video/x-h264,stream-format=byte-stream ! rtph264pay pt=96 config-interval=1 mtu={payload_mtu}
payloader.hevc: h265parse config-interval=-1 ! video/x-h265,stream-format=byte-stream ! rtph265pay pt=96 mtu={payload_mtu}

h264.name: nvcodec-h264
h264.pipeline: cudaupload ! cudaconvertscale add-borders=true ! video/x-raw(memory:CUDAMemory),format=NV12,width={width},height={height},pixel-aspect-ratio=1/1 ! nvh264enc preset=low-latency-hq zerolatency=true gop-size=0 rc-mode=cbr-ld-hq bitrate={bitrate_kbps} vbv-buffer-size={vbv_buffer_kbits} aud=false

h264.name: vaapi-h264
h264.pipeline: vapostproc add-borders=true ! video/x-raw(memory:VAMemory),format=NV12,width={width},height={height},pixel-aspect-ratio=1/1 ! vah264enc aud=false b-frames=0 ref-frames=1 bitrate={bitrate_kbps} cpb-size={vbv_buffer_kbits} rate-control=cbr target-usage=6

h264.name: qsv-h264
h264.pipeline: vapostproc add-borders=true ! video/x-raw(memory:VAMemory),format=NV12,width={width},height={height},pixel-aspect-ratio=1/1 ! qsvh264enc b-frames=0 gop-size=0 idr-interval=1 ref-frames=1 bitrate={bitrate_kbps} rate-control=cbr low-latency=1 target-usage=6

h264.name: software-h264
h264.pipeline: videoconvert ! video/x-raw,format=I420,width={width},height={height},framerate={fps}/1 ! x264enc tune=zerolatency speed-preset=superfast b-adapt=false bframes=0 ref=1 key-int-max=0 bitrate={bitrate_kbps} aud=false

hevc.name: nvcodec-hevc
hevc.pipeline: cudaupload ! cudaconvertscale add-borders=true ! video/x-raw(memory:CUDAMemory),format=NV12,width={width},height={height},pixel-aspect-ratio=1/1 ! nvh265enc gop-size=-1 bitrate={bitrate_kbps} vbv-buffer-size={vbv_buffer_kbits} aud=false rc-mode=cbr zerolatency=true preset=p1 tune=ultra-low-latency multi-pass=two-pass-quarter

hevc.name: vaapi-hevc
hevc.pipeline: vapostproc add-borders=true ! video/x-raw(memory:VAMemory),format=NV12,width={width},height={height},pixel-aspect-ratio=1/1 ! vah265enc aud=false b-frames=0 ref-frames=1 bitrate={bitrate_kbps} cpb-size={vbv_buffer_kbits} rate-control=cbr target-usage=6

hevc.name: qsv-hevc
hevc.pipeline: vapostproc add-borders=true ! video/x-raw(memory:VAMemory),format=NV12,width={width},height={height},pixel-aspect-ratio=1/1 ! qsvh265enc b-frames=0 gop-size=0 idr-interval=1 ref-frames=1 bitrate={bitrate_kbps} rate-control=cbr low-latency=1 target-usage=6

av1.name: nvcodec-av1
av1.pipeline: cudaupload ! cudaconvertscale add-borders=true ! video/x-raw(memory:CUDAMemory),format=NV12,width={width},height={height},pixel-aspect-ratio=1/1 ! nvav1enc gop-size=-1 bitrate={bitrate_kbps} vbv-buffer-size={vbv_buffer_kbits} rc-mode=cbr zerolatency=true preset=p1 tune=ultra-low-latency multi-pass=two-pass-quarter

av1.pipeline: vapostproc add-borders=true ! video/x-raw(memory:VAMemory),format=NV12,width={width},height={height},pixel-aspect-ratio=1/1 ! vaav1enc ref-frames=1 bitrate={bitrate_kbps} cpb-size={vbv_buffer_kbits} rate-control=cbr target-usage=6
